description: Make an infographic PNG (1080x1350) or a 15s motion clip MP4 (1080x1920, Remotion) from a post, built by the user's OWN connected Claude Code (or Codex) on their BAMF Cloud computer. Runs inside BAMF chat: returns the exact chat message that starts it there. BAMF never uses its own Claude/Codex access; if the user has not connected one, the chat asks them to. The file lands in the media library as a draft; nothing is published.

brief.description: What to make; optional extra direction.

post_id.description: Source post id (optional; defaults to the post open in chat).

name: bamf.run_design_session
